agent.description: Which spawnable agent to run (e.g. researcher, code-analyst, knowledge-worker), or "auto" to pick the best-fitting agent for the task.

task.description: A complete, self-contained instruction for the agent (it has no other context).

model.description: Run the agent on this model (a catalog model id or name from list_models) instead of its profile's own. Judged by the routing policy; a model that is unknown or not allowed for this work fails the call with the reason, it never falls back.

probe.description: Run as a probe: every call with effects outside the run (writes, task and todo creation, non-GET requests) is answered with a stub saying what would have happened, and is not executed. The result's `trajectory` shows each call. For trying an agent under a candidate `harness`, or seeing what it would do.

harness.description: Probe only: run the agent under a candidate harness instead of its profile's: `system_prompt` (the whole prompt) and/or `tools` (its toolset, registry tools only). Other keys are ignored; JSON text is accepted. The result's `harness` is what the run used.

read_only.description: Strip the agent's write tools for this run (store_note, write_workspace_file, …), as a chat sub-agent runs. For a draft or an answer that must not be saved anywhere.

max_rounds.description: Tool-use rounds the agent may take (default 8, capped at 16). Raise it for work that must iterate on a result, such as compiling code and fixing the errors.

verify.description: Checked against the agent's real tool trace after it runs. If any requirement is unmet, the answer is prefixed with an `UNVERIFIED — …` line naming what was missing, and store_note then stores it as unsourced_synthesis, never semantic.

answer_requires.description: Calls a claim in the answer stands for: when `when` (a regex; `^` is a line start) matches the answer, each of `tools` (`tool` or `tool:action`) must have run, e.g. [{"when": "^Source: https?://", "tools": ["create_task"]}].

retry.description: When a requirement is unmet, run the agent once more on the task, told what fell short and which calls already ran; the result is the second run's (`retried_after` lists the first run's failures). Not in a probe.

require_tools.description: Tools that must have run and succeeded at least once (e.g. ["mcp_call"] to require a page was read); `tool:action` requires that action (e.g. "manage_plugin:write"). A probe's stubbed call does not count.

code_requires_tests.description: If the answer contains a ```rust block, require an execute_code run whose tests all passed (at least one).

rerun_answer_code.description: Compile and test the answer's own ```rust code in the sandbox after the run (and clippy it, with code_requires_clippy_clean), instead of trusting the agent's reported runs.

code_requires_clippy_clean.description: If the answer contains a ```rust block, the last execute_code clippy run must have reported no findings.

cited_paths_exist.description: Every `path:line` the answer cites must exist in the codebase with at least that many lines.

question.description: The question the agent was asked; read by require_code_if_question_mentions.

require_code_if_question_mentions.description: If `question` names any of these words (whole word, any case), the answer must contain a ```rust block; with code_requires_tests it must also be backed by a passing test.
